A1.justification: Both PDFs describe DeSiRe-GS. Their text, equations, tables, figures and complete supplementary material support reliable comparison, including matching content across appendix pagination changes.

before.justification: v1 reports original DeSiRe-GS reconstruction, novel-view synthesis and depth results, including component ablations in Table 3 and supplementary results in Table 4.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results and expands the qualitative feature-extractor comparison in Figure 8.

M1.justification: The two-stage motion-mask extraction and PVG-based decomposition procedure, geometric regularization, temporal consistency and training objectives are unchanged. The revised Figure 8 adds evidence about existing components.

E1.justification: Both versions retain Waymo and KITTI coverage, including the PVG, OmniRe and NOTR subsets, for the same reconstruction and decomposition tasks. Figure 8 reuses a driving scene already illustrated in Figure 10.

E2.justification: Corresponding benchmark tables retain their comparator sets, and Figure 8 continues to compare FiT3D with DINOv2. The added references and reference-mask visualization introduce no additional baseline method.

E3.justification: Figure 8 expands the qualitative evaluation to include extracted masks alongside a reference mask derived from bounding boxes and trajectories. Existing dataset splits, camera configurations, preprocessing, training budgets and quantitative metrics remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Figure 8 extends the feature-only comparison with similarity maps and downstream motion masks, allowing closer inspection of FiT3D versus DINOv2 localization and spurious responses. Table 3's component ablations and the other qualitative analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Both versions retain single-valued numerical reporting. Neither adds repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests or other statistical uncertainty estimates.

E6.justification: All numerical results in Tables 1–4 are unchanged. Revised Figure 8 adds similarity and mask-comparison outputs, including DINOv2's spurious responses and an annotation-derived reference, for a scene already represented in Figure 10.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulations in Equations 1–26 and the assumptions underlying temporal geometric consistency are unchanged. No formal result, proof or derivation is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims concerning self-supervised decomposition, surface reconstruction, geometric consistency and performance relative to prior methods.

C2.justification: The explanations concerning FiT3D feature quality, Gaussian overfitting, LiDAR sparsity and cross-view consistency are retained. The expanded visualization supports existing interpretations without adding substantive limitations or applicability qualifications.

D1.justification: Figure 8's caption newly documents that its reference masks use ground-truth bounding boxes and associated trajectories following EmerNeRF. Hardware, optimizer settings, training schedules, preprocessing instructions and code-access information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Six references are added, including Point Mamba, DVLO, DelFlow and Q-SLAM. Sections 1–2 modestly broaden the context to tracking and point-cloud representations, while retaining the paper's positioning relative to existing scene-reconstruction methods.

P1.justification: Localized edits revise the related-work opening, add a Berkeley DeepDrive acknowledgement, abbreviate conference names and clarify references to Tables 5–6. Most prose and the section sequence remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 8 becomes a larger feature, similarity and mask comparison grid with an expanded caption, shifting Figure 9 and subsequent appendix text. Figures 4–5 are resampled without changing their depicted content; table structures are retained.

improvement.justification: The revised Figure 8 makes the FiT3D/DINOv2 comparison more directly assessable through downstream masks and an explained annotation-derived reference. This modestly strengthens qualitative support for the feature-extractor choice. The method, quantitative validation and core claims remain unchanged.
